2A.5 SOTP ASSUMPTION SET — Amazon.com (AMZN), NTM+1 (per GS convention as of 31 Jul 2026)

Reconstructed GS-style SOTP block replicating the published GS valuation
(GS 31 Jul 2026: PT $375, NTM+1 SOTP — North America 16x EV/GAAP EBIT,
International 1.25x EV/Sales, AWS 29x EV/GAAP EBIT, less net debt $59,220mn,
divided by 10,974mn diluted shares). GS applies EV/EBIT-style multiples to
pre-tax GAAP EBIT, hence group tax rate 0 in the engine (no double tax
adjustment). Segment EBITs are GS NTM+1 estimates (NA $52,251mn, AWS
$105,842mn); revenues shown for value-split display — NA/AWS from GS CY27E
segment estimates ($518,601mn / $248,890mn), International as published on
the NTM+1 EV/Sales basis ($209,723mn). GS downside/upside scenarios: 12x/20x
NA, 1.0x/1.5x Intl, 16x/34x AWS -> $200/$475.
